Application Data.NAME: Blooming Creations LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Blooming Creations LLC specializes in the design, manufacture, and retail of high-quality artificial flowers and floral supplies. Our operations include creating custom floral arrangements for various occasions such as weddings, corporate events, and home decor. In addition, we offer a wide range of floral accessories, including vases, ribbons, and decorative fillers, to enhance our customers' creative projects. Our team is dedicated to providing exceptional customer service and personalized consultations to help clients select the perfect items for their needs. We operate from our retail location as well as online, allowing us to reach a broader audience and cater to both individual customers and businesses.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On February 15, 2023, a water pipe burst in our retail location, causing water damage to inventory and fixtures. The estimated loss amounted to $2,000. The claim was submitted to our insurance provider and is currently in the review process, with a final decision expected by March 30, 2023.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols and a perimeter fence with motion sensors.
